title: The Mutual Observer File Pair: A Minimal Constraint Geometry for Proto-Living Digital Objects

canonicalSharedCommitment.derivation: SHA-256 of the newline-delimited ordered PDF and DOCX source SHA-256 digests.

accessProtocol: Resolve the current pair manifest and both member records.
Verify each source file against its member SHA-256 digest.
Verify that each member record identifies the other member as its partner and contains the same canonical shared commitment.
Append a jointly signed or otherwise immutable residue record to the ledger before treating a read as a mutually verified access.
publicationNote: The original PDF and DOCX are preserved without alteration. The member records and ledger specification provide the machine-readable mutual-observer packaging layer.
